ideas.title: The Politics of Federal Funding
ideas.description: Investigate the use of federal funding as a political tool, including the Trump administration's withholding of public health grants to Democratic-led states.
questions: What is the extent of the Trump administration's use of federal funding as a political tool?
How have Democratic-led states been affected by the withholding of public health grants?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a significant pattern of abuse of power by the Trump administration, and could have major implications for public health programs across the country.
